static_traits.name: Luo Qian
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents and a young younger sibling
static_traits.social_status: 与新队友连接困难,感觉not属于团队;家庭支持但not完全理解作为Athlete的压力
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received before;问题在一个月前加入新球队后出现
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,逻辑较好,配合度高,略显紧张并能进行自我Reflection

basic_info.main_problem: 加入新球队后,总是坐在替补席,觉得自己很without用,这种Self-denial影响了训练与比赛的动力,场上表现以及整体心理健康.
basic_info.core_demands: 希望找到方法跨越'without能/without用'的感觉,因为这些感受正在影响其场上表现和整体心理健康.
growth_experiences: In the previous team, showed confidence, was often praised by the former coach for skill and effort, and was once regarded as an outstanding player on the team; this positive experience constitutes an early source of self-efficacy and a sense of capability.
一个月前加入新球队后,新的环境与对表现的压力trigger了强烈Self-doubt;在训练与比赛中感到被评判,更多时间坐在替补席,尝试与教练和队友沟通,寻求反馈与建议,但not yet能缓解without力感与not属于感.
Overall family support,可倾诉,但家人对作为Athlete所承受的专业压力理解有限,支持更多停留在情感层面而非专业指导.

special_situations.event: Sits on the bench for a long time during team training or matches
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能上场,就说明I have no value,能力not足
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Seeks feedback and advice from coaches and teammates, and tries to perform harder in training
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我很without用,教练永远not会重视我

special_situations.event: Feeling judged by others in training or competitions with the new team
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人觉得I am not good enough,就证明我not属于这里
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: On the field, nervous and hesitant, reduces risks and attempts to avoid mistakes being seen
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们在看not起我,认为I am not good enough

special_situations.event: After joining the new team, facing higher expectations and pressure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能尽快证明自己,就会一直被忽视,have not上场机会
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Willingness to participate in training and competitions decreases, producing avoidance and procrastination
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远without法证明自己,教练not会看到我的价值

special_situations.event: At night before falling asleep, repeatedly thinks about the day's training and match
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not把所有错误反复琢磨,就会继续失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overthinks, ignores positive episodes, sacrifices sleep in hopes of improving
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I did terribly today; I must correct all the problems

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as a valuable team member, gain playing opportunities, and feel belonging
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评判为without能,Being rejected或边缘化
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of safety by reducing exposure and avoiding evaluation
以自我批评来先行消解外界negate的打击

object_relations.object_representation: An old coach who supported and affirmed

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈及'被评判'的经历或他人的反馈not yet能立刻缓解其Anxiety时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将他人的中性或建设性反馈理解为负面评判与negate(移情:将外界视为挑剔者)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以温和Clarification与Empathy的语气,承认其感受,区分事实与Interpretation,避免评判用语,邀请具体证据与当下体验.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing 'showing oneself' or being asked to be more proactive in training/competitions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 若not能完美表现就会Being rejected,因此将挫败转向自我批评与自责
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use支持性与具体化的Questioning,降低自我苛责语气,强调过程与渐进目标,鼓励识do not可控小步骤.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When placed on the bench or discussing playing eligibility
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Views self and others in binary terms of 'substitute = failure, playing = success'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Uses a gentle contrast-and-integration strategy, points out shades of gray and multidimensional performance, invites them to see both strengths and areas needing improvement at once, and avoids absolutist words.

manifestations: 在新球队中感到not属于,难以与队友建立联系
Views others as judges; reduces open contact
自我标签为'without用',质疑自身价值
Equating being a substitute with failure, hard to experience achievement and meaning

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Treats 'must prove oneself immediately in a new environment' as a rigid standard
Measures self-worth mainly by others' expectations

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on.
manifestations: Tense on the field, hesitating, second-guessing
Overly concerned with others' judgments; repeatedly criticizes oneself
Reduces proactive contact for fear of negative evaluation

positive_force: 具备真实竞skill力与成功经验(曾被旧教练频繁称赞)
Actively seeks feedback and professional help (communicates with coach and teammates, enters counseling)
Family emotional support available to confide in
Willing to try behavioral experiments and keep an open mind
negative_force: Overly concerned with others' judgment; mind-reading tendency
睡眠被打乱与Decreased drive形成恶性循环

target_behavior.behavior: 回避或减少参加训练与比赛的Decreased drive
antecedent: Facing high expectations and pressure after joining a new team
Being assigned as a substitute in training or competitions
Feeling judged by the coach and teammates
target_behavior.core_reason: 将'not上场=失败'作黑白化Interpretation,预测会被negate并因此回避以减少Anxiety
target_behavior.function: Avoids negative evaluation and the sense of failure, temporarily maintaining psychological safety
target_behavior.consequence: 训练与Performance declining further,难以获得上场机会,Reinforcement'not属于团队'的感受

target_behavior.behavior: 在场上紧张,犹豫,反复Self-doubt与二次猜测
antecedent: Teammates or coaches suggest being 'more confident'
Subjectively feeling that others are judging oneself
target_behavior.core_reason: Highly dependent on external validation, with excessive worry about mistakes and mind-reading tendencies
target_behavior.function: Reduces the possibility of being criticized by cutting back on risk-taking and trying
target_behavior.consequence: 动作迟缓,表现更差,形成Anxiety—失误—自责的恶性循环

antecedent: Replaying training and match performance at night
Focuses on negative details, ignoring the positive parts
target_behavior.core_reason: 试图通过反复思考控制失败与Anxiety,存在心理过滤与'必须纠正所有问题'的僵化规则
target_behavior.function: 以认知过度控制来暂时缓解not确定感
target_behavior.consequence: 睡眠not足,Recovery差,次日训练与比赛状态进一步下降

target_behavior.behavior: 自我贬损言语(如'我很without用')
antecedent: After sitting on the bench or making a mistake
遭遇新环境压力与not属于感
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalized negative core beliefs and a personalization interpretation pattern
target_behavior.function: 通过Self-denial先行缓冲外界negate的潜在打击
target_behavior.consequence: 自尊与Decreased drive,Interpersonal alienation,进一步影响竞技表现与团队融入
